app.name: Cage
app.tagline: Someone is watching over every trip

checkIn.question: Are you OK?
checkIn.noAnswer: If you don't answer, Cage will alert your safety circle.

circle.name: Safety circle

onboarding.title: Who should hear if something's wrong?

circle.nudge: Add one more person, in case the first doesn't pick up.
circle.order: The person at the top hears first.
circle.removeBody: {{name}} will no longer hear from Cage.

errors.load: Couldn't load the list. Check your connection and try again.
errors.error: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.own_number: That's your own number. Add someone else's.
errors.circle_full: You already have {{max}} people. Remove one to add someone new.

permission.title: Choose from contacts
permission.body: Cage only keeps the people you pick. Your contacts are never uploaded.
permission.denied: Cage can't see your contacts. You can type a number instead.

picker.title: Pick from contacts
picker.empty: No numbers in your contacts yet.
picker.loadError: Couldn't read your contacts. You can type a number instead.
picker.full: You can pick up to {{max}} people.

circle.body: They get messages by SMS or Zalo. No app needed.

web.linkStops: This link turns off when {{name}} arrives
web.linkEnded: This trip has ended. The link no longer shares location.
web.checkInTitle: Cage is checking that {{name}} is OK
web.checkInBody: Nothing to do yet. If {{name}} doesn't answer, Cage will tell you.
web.duressBody: On {{name}}'s phone everything looks normal. Someone may be next to {{name}}, watching.
web.messageFirstWhy: A stranger may be next to {{name}}.
web.doNotContactWhy: Someone next to them may see it.
web.lostBatteryTitle: {{name}}'s phone may have run out of battery
web.lostBody: Last seen at {{time}} with {{battery}} battery. {{name}} was due at {{arrival}}.
web.lostBodyNoUpdate: Cage hasn't had a location yet. {{name}} was due at {{arrival}}.

phone.title: Your phone number
phone.body: You'll get a 6-digit code to sign in.
phone.label: Phone number

errors.too_many: This number has had too many codes. Try again in an hour.
errors.error: Couldn't send the code. Check your connection and try again.

errors.wrong: That code isn't right. Try again or get a new one.
errors.too_many: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.error: Couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.

safe.title: Set your safe code
safe.body: Enter this code whenever Cage asks, to say you're OK.

duress.title: Set your duress code
duress.body: If someone forces you to enter a code, use this one. The phone looks normal, but your safety circle is told.

errors.too_simple: That code is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.too_close: The duress code must differ from the safe code in at least 2 digits.
errors.mismatch: The two entries don't match. Start again.
errors.error: Couldn't save the codes. Check your connection and try again.
errors.journey_open: You're on a trip. End it first, then reset your codes.

reset.title: Reset your codes
reset.body: Cage sends a 6-digit code to {{phone}} to check it's you. Then you set new codes and the old ones stop working.

messages.code: Your verification code is {{code}}. Don't share it with anyone.
messages.journeyStarted: {{name}} just started a trip to {{destination}}, due at {{time}}. Follow at {{url}}

alert.no_answer: {{name}} didn't answer a check-in call. See where they are at {{url}}. Message first, don't call yet.
alert.duress: {{name}} just entered their emergency code. See where they are at {{url}}. Don't call or message {{name}}: someone next to them may see it.
alert.sos: {{name}} just pressed SOS. See where they are at {{url}}. Message first, don't call yet.
alert.lost_contact: Cage lost contact with {{name}} after they were due to arrive. Last location at {{url}}

messages.lostContactBattery: Cage lost contact with {{name}} after they were due to arrive. Their battery was nearly empty, so the phone probably died. Last location at {{url}}
messages.safeNow: {{name}} confirmed they're safe with their safe code. Nothing more to do.

demo.band: Demo server · No messages sent, no real calls
demo.title: Demo dashboard
demo.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in 15 minutes.
demo.off: This server doesn't have demo mode on.
demo.pickBody: Start a trip on the phone first. The traveller then shows up here.
demo.restartConfirm: Delete this trip? The account and safety circle stay.
demo.gone: This trip has ended or was deleted.
demo.callsOff: Demo: call and message buttons are off

plan.title: Where are you going?
plan.destinationHint: For example: Bờ Sông guesthouse, District 1
plan.checkNote: If anything looks wrong, Cage will ask you straight away.
plan.notFound: Couldn't find that address. Try adding the district.
plan.needLocation: Cage needs your location so your circle can see you on the way.
plan.error: Couldn't start. Check your connection and try again.

onRoute.sharing: Your safety circle can see where you are

ask.autoAlert: If time runs out, Cage tells your safety circle.

enterCode.title: Enter your code
enterCode.endBody: Enter your code to stop sharing your location.
enterCode.forgot: Forgot your code? Let the time run out and Cage will tell your circle.

alerted.title: Your circle has been told
alerted.body: They can see where you are. When you're OK, enter your code.
alerted.lostBody: Your safety circle was told and can see your last location.

arrived.title: Trip ended
arrived.body: Your circle no longer sees your location.
